name: framecraft
title: FrameCraft
description: Capture frames, edit subtitle layers, and export clips from Jellyfin, Emby, or IINA using FFmpeg.
author: stardryjun

preferences.name: jellyfinUrl
preferences.title: Server URL
preferences.description: URL of your Jellyfin or Emby server, the same address you open in a browser (e.g. https://media.example.com). Required when your player streams from Jellyfin/Emby. Emby support is experimental.

preferences.name: jellyfinApiKey
preferences.title: API Key
preferences.description: Create one in the server dashboard under API Keys. This is not your login password.
preferences.placeholder: API key from the server dashboard

preferences.name: jellyfinUsername
preferences.title: User Name Filter
preferences.description: Optional. Only follow this user's playback when several people stream at once.

preferences.name: saveDirectory
preferences.title: Save Location
preferences.description: Where captures and clips are saved. Defaults to ~/Pictures/FrameCraft.

preferences.name: defaultSubtitleMode
preferences.title: Default Subtitles
preferences.description: Which subtitle tracks are shown in the exported image. Every extractable track is still kept as a layer in the SVG.

data.title: Primary track (Chinese, then English, then any)

preferences.name: ffmpegPath
preferences.title: FFmpeg Path
preferences.description: Leave empty to use Homebrew's FFmpeg. Only set this if FFmpeg is installed elsewhere.

preferences.name: bypassProxy
preferences.title: Network
preferences.label: Connect directly (ignore proxy)
preferences.description: Ignore system proxy variables when reading video. Uncheck if your server is only reachable through a proxy.

preferences.name: copyToClipboard
preferences.title: Clipboard
preferences.label: Copy image when done
preferences.description: Copy the finished image to the clipboard.

commands.name: capture-frame
commands.title: Capture Frame
commands.description: Capture the paused frame at full quality, with subtitle layers

commands.name: clip-in
commands.title: Mark Clip Start
commands.description: Mark the current position as the start of a clip

commands.name: clip-out
commands.title: Export Clip
commands.description: Export the clip from the marked start to the current position

commands.name: studio
commands.title: Capture Gallery
commands.description: Browse captures, manage tasks and edit subtitle layers

commands.name: copy-stream-url
commands.title: Copy Stream URL
commands.description: Copy the URL or path of the video that is playing
